title: Pricing FAQ early next week
transcript:
[00:00] Tobias: Last item. The new annual plan goes live on the 16th, and sales keeps getting the same five questions.
[00:08] Wen: Proration, seat changes mid-year, refunds, currency, and whether the discount stacks with the nonprofit one.
[00:15] Adaeze: We need a pricing FAQ on the site before the launch email goes out.
[00:21] Tobias: When does the launch email go?
[00:25] Adaeze: The plan is the morning of the 16th, but marketing wants the FAQ link in the draft before then.
[00:33] Wen: I can write the FAQ. Most of the answers are already in the sales notes.
[00:40] Tobias: Great. Let's aim for early next week for the FAQ, then.
[00:45] Wen: Early next week, sure.
[00:49] Adaeze: Run the refund answer past finance before it goes up.
[00:54] Wen: Yes, I'll send that one to Gareth first.
[00:58] Tobias: And the nonprofit stacking question, the answer is no, they don't stack.
[01:04] Adaeze: Then we should say that plainly. People will try.
[01:08] Wen: Got it. Plain no, with a line on which discount wins.
[01:13] Tobias: Perfect. Thanks, all.
